name: sites
description: Publish a web page the agent built - a dashboard, a report, a landing page - at a real address on this instance, and decide who may open it: only you, the Project's people, any signed-in account, named guests, or everyone. The agent builds with its own toolchain and hands over the finished output; every publish is an immutable release you can roll back.

configSchema.label: Default visibility
configSchema.hint: What a newly created site is visible to before anyone changes it. A site never becomes public on its own; that is confirmed here in the app.

configSchema.label: Allow public sites
configSchema.hint: When off, every site requires signing in and the public option disappears from each site's access settings.

configSchema.label: Dedicated site hostname
configSchema.hint: Serve published sites from their own hostname instead of this instance's. Recommended: a page on a separate origin cannot reach the app's session, so sites served there may run their own scripts. Without it, pages are served next to the app and their scripts stay disabled.
configSchema.help: Point the hostname at this machine and forward it to the daemon with the request path unchanged. The hostname needs its own certificate.

configSchema.label: Who may publish
configSchema.hint: Whether an ordinary account's agent may create and publish sites. Opening a site somebody shared is unaffected.

configSchema.label: Largest file
configSchema.hint: Files larger than this are refused when publishing. A published file is held in memory while it is served, so this is a real ceiling rather than a preference.

configSchema.label: Largest site
configSchema.hint: Total size of one published release.

configSchema.label: Sites per account
configSchema.hint: How many sites one account may keep at once.

configSchema.label: Releases kept
configSchema.hint: Older releases beyond this count are removed. The release a site currently serves is never removed, whatever this is set to.

configSchema.label: Sign-in validity
configSchema.hint: How long a visitor stays signed in to a site before the browser is sent back through the sign-in step. Losing access takes effect immediately regardless of this, because permission is checked on every request.

strings.title: Sites
strings.subtitle: Pages your agent published, and who can open them.
strings.empty: No sites yet. Ask the agent to build one and publish it.
strings.emptyShared: Nobody has shared a site with you.
strings.guestsHint: These accounts can open the site whatever the setting above says.
strings.publicWarning: Anyone who knows the address will be able to open this site without signing in.
strings.publicDisabled: Public sites are turned off for this instance.
strings.passiveNotice: Scripts are disabled at this address. Set a dedicated site hostname in the plugin settings to run them.
strings.sourceNotice: The source folder lives in the Project, so everyone with access to the Project can read it. This setting governs the published site.
strings.deleteHint: The address stops working and every release is removed. The source folder in the Project is left alone.
